pwa.message: Install the app on your phone or PC to use it instantly and offline on the shop floor
pwa.installedSuccessDesc: You can launch CNC HUB directly from your home screen.
pwa.freeAppNotice: The app is 100% free and does not require Google Play / App Store downloads.
pwa.pcPromptAvailable: Install CNC HUB as a standalone application on your Windows/Mac desktop.
pwa.modalSubtitle: Select your device for a quick step-by-step walkthrough

pc.title: Desktop (Chrome, Edge, Brave)
pc.step1: In the browser address bar (on the right side), click the Install App icon (monitor with arrow or plus icon).
pc.step2: Alternatively: click the three-dot menu ⋮ at top right and choose 'Install CNC HUB' or 'Apps > Install'.
pc.step3: Click 'Install'. The app will launch in its own standalone window and appear on your Desktop.

android.title: Android Smartphone (Chrome / Edge / Brave)
android.step1: In Chrome or Brave, tap the three-dot menu (⋮) in the top-right corner of the screen.
android.step2: From the menu, choose 'Install app' or 'Add to Home screen'.
android.step4: The CNC HUB icon will appear on your home screen and run in standalone fullscreen mode.

ios.title: iPhone / iPad (Safari)
ios.inAppWarning: Opened in Facebook / Messenger / Instagram App
ios.inAppDesc: Apple blocks PWA installation inside social media in-app browsers. To add the app to your Home Screen, you must open this page in Safari.
ios.selectBrowser: Which browser are you using on iPhone?
ios.step1: Make sure you are in Safari (Apple requires Safari for full PWA installation).
ios.step2: Tap the Share button on the bottom bar (box with an upward arrow ⎋).
ios.step3: Scroll down and select 'Add to Home Screen' (plus icon +).
ios.step4: Tap 'Add' in the top right corner. The CNC HUB icon will appear on your Home Screen.
ios.inAppStep1: Tap the three-dot menu (⋯) or Share icon in the top-right or bottom-right corner.
ios.inAppStep2: From the menu, choose 'Open in Safari' or 'Open in external browser'.
ios.inAppStep3: Once in Safari, tap Share ⎋ ➔ 'Add to Home Screen' ➔ 'Add'.
ios.chromeStep1: In Chrome address bar or menu, tap the Share icon or the three-dot menu ⋯.
ios.chromeStep2: Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen' (supported in iOS 16.4+).
ios.chromeStep3: If this option is missing in your Chrome version, copy cnchub.app link and open in Safari.

pwa.desktopDesc: Runs in a standalone window without browser bars – like a native Windows/Mac app.

liabilityItems: The CNC Calculator app is an auxiliary and educational tool only. All formulas, cutting parameter selections (Vc, fz, n, Vf), fit and ISO 2768 tables, seat and groove dimensions and generated hole coordinates (PCD) are provided AS IS.

Verification duty: the user (operator, programmer, process engineer) must always verify calculated values against the machine documentation, the cutting tool manufacturer data sheets and the part drawing.

No liability: the author and owner of the app accept no liability for any direct or indirect material damage, in particular machine collisions, spindle damage, broken tools, scrapped parts, production downtime or personal injury resulting from using the calculator results.
privacyItems: No personal data: the app requires no registration, no sign-in and no personal data.
Device local storage: all entered dimensions, the material inventory list and unit/language preferences are stored only locally in your browser. This data is never sent to external servers.

Cookieless Cloudflare analytics: the site uses anonymous Cloudflare Web Analytics. It sets no cookies, does not track users across sites and collects no IP addresses or device fingerprints. Only aggregated visit statistics (page views, country, browser type) are collected.
